# authwise_provider_magic_link (Data Source)

A one-time link and code sent by email. Unset fields take kit's defaults: a 6-digit code, a 10-minute ttl, `LINK_AND_CODE`. Builds a ProviderMagicLink config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `code_length` (Number)
- `identifier_attribute` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `ttl` (String) `ttl` as a duration: `"5s"`, `"1.5s"`, `"500ms"`, `"1m30s"`.

### Read-Only

- `any` (String) protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (includes `@type`); reference this from Any-typed resource attributes.
